verdict.rationale: Jan ships a local OpenAI-compatible server powered by llama.cpp. It documents GET /v1/models and chat-completions endpoints, and the desktop docs claim you can "switch freely between local and frontier models." Together these imply multiple models are available through the running server, but nothing explicitly documents loading or switching models on the server without a restart. Missing for 10: explicit docs on hot-loading or swapping models on the running API server, concurrent multi-model loading, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
